test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter cluster.

PRIEST : TSRPIE :: UMPIRE : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values: 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 
• The words are arranged in descending order.

Given:

PRIEST : TSRPIE

P(16) R(18) I(9) E(5) S(19) T(20) : T(20) S(19) R(18) P(16) I(9) E(5) **(Desending order)**

Similarly,

UMPIRE : ?

U(21) M(13) P(16) I(9) R(18) E(5) : U(21) R(18) P(16) M(13) I(9) E(5) **(Desending order)**

Hence **the correct answer is option (3)**
